figures.title: No-wave control: Eulerian current through the tank
figures.caption: Saved y-averaged Eulerian along-wave velocity: prescribed Stokes drift is subtracted at native x faces, then adjacent faces are averaged. Same colour scale within this figure. figures.title: No-wave control: Current profiles
figures.caption: Eulerian y-mean velocity averaged over 1 ≤ x ≤ 11 m at selected times. Absolute profiles retain the mean offset. These snapshots use different windows from the final laboratory comparison.

figures.title: No-wave control: Velocity history
figures.caption: Native volume-weighted RMS of the full Lagrangian velocity, including its mean and prescribed wave contribution. This is not turbulent RMS, an Eulerian energy, or a mixing-rate diagnostic.

notices: Only verified finished runs are shown. A pending label means no completion receipt has been verified; it does not distinguish queued, running, or failed jobs.
Member figures are individual realizations. Final laboratory and ensemble diagnostics appear only after the complete analysis passes its source and file-integrity checks.
The original seven retained seeds exclude upstream numerical failures 5 and 9. This gallery preserves that selection; it is not a population-unbiased or convergence study.
No tracer was simulated. Vertical momentum flux and ky = 0 energy alone do not establish a transport barrier or a Taylor–Proudman regime.
Initial-condition, source and validation checks do not substitute for physical validation against the laboratory data.
